title: 👵 Grandma's Recipes
subtitle: 30 traditional dishes and sweets from the Gargano, passed down from generation to generation
ricetta_1_ingredienti: 400g homemade orecchiette, 500g peeled tomatoes, 1 onion, olive oil, basil, salt, grated pecorino
ricetta_1_preparazione: Sauté the chopped onion in oil, add the tomatoes and cook the sauce for 30 minutes over low heat. Cook the orecchiette in salted water, drain and toss with the sauce. Finish with fresh basil and plenty of pecorino.
ricetta_2_nome: Fava Bean Purée with Wild Chicory
ricetta_2_ingredienti: 300g dried peeled fava beans, 500g wild chicory, olive oil, salt, chili pepper
ricetta_2_preparazione: Cook the fava beans in water for about an hour until they form a creamy purée, stirring occasionally. Blanch the chicory and sauté it in oil with chili pepper. Serve the fava bean purée with the chicory on top and a drizzle of oil.
ricetta_3_ingredienti: 400g cavatelli, 200g arugula, 2 cherry tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, pecorino
ricetta_3_preparazione: Cook the cavatelli in salted water together with the torn arugula in the last few minutes. Drain and dress with oil, sautéed garlic, raw cherry tomatoes and grated pecorino.
ricetta_4_ingredienti: 500g flour, brewer's yeast, water, salt, mozzarella, tomato, oil for frying
ricetta_4_preparazione: Prepare a soft dough with flour, yeast, water and salt, and let it rise for 2 hours. Shape into discs, fill with mozzarella and tomato, fold into a half-moon and fry in boiling oil until golden.
ricetta_5_ingredienti: 800g soaked salt cod, cherry tomatoes, olives, capers, garlic, olive oil, parsley
ricetta_5_preparazione: Brown the garlic in oil, add cherry tomatoes, olives and capers. Add the salt cod cut into pieces and cook over low heat for 20 minutes, adding a little water as needed. Sprinkle with parsley before serving.
ricetta_6_nome: Braised Rolled Meat (Braciole) in Tomato Sauce
ricetta_6_ingredienti: 8 thin slices of horse or veal meat, garlic, parsley, pecorino, peeled tomatoes, olive oil, red wine
ricetta_6_preparazione: Fill the slices with garlic, parsley and pecorino, roll them up and tie with kitchen twine. Brown in oil, deglaze with wine and cook in the tomato sauce for at least 2 hours over a gentle heat.
ricetta_7_ingredienti: sun-dried sweet peppers, olive oil for frying, salt
ricetta_7_preparazione: Quickly fry the dried peppers in boiling oil for a few seconds, until they become crispy and puffed. Drain on paper towels and lightly salt before serving.
ricetta_8_ingredienti: 1 semi-aged caciocavallo cheese, oregano, chili pepper, olive oil
ricetta_8_preparazione: Slice the caciocavallo thickly and grill on a very hot griddle until a golden crust forms on the outside while the inside stays stringy and melted. Serve hot with a drizzle of oil, oregano and chili pepper.
ricetta_9_ingredienti: 1kg turnip tops, garlic, chili pepper, olive oil, salt
ricetta_9_preparazione: Boil the turnip tops in salted water for a few minutes. Drain and sauté in a pan with garlic, chili pepper and plenty of olive oil until well flavored.
ricetta_10_nome: Eggplant in Tomato Sauce (Melanzane a Funghetto)
ricetta_10_ingredienti: 3 eggplants, cherry tomatoes, garlic, basil, olive oil, salt
ricetta_10_preparazione: Dice the eggplants and fry in oil until golden. Add cherry tomatoes and chopped garlic, cook for another 10 minutes and finish with fresh basil.
ricetta_11_ingredienti: 1.5kg lamb, cut into pieces, rosemary, wild thyme, garlic, white wine, olive oil, potatoes
ricetta_11_preparazione: Brown the lamb in oil with garlic and aromatic herbs. Deglaze with white wine, add the potatoes cut into chunks and bake at 180°C for one hour, turning occasionally.
ricetta_12_ingredienti: 1.5kg kid goat, cut into pieces, potatoes, rosemary, garlic, olive oil, white wine
ricetta_12_preparazione: Arrange the kid and potato wedges in a roasting pan with oil, garlic and rosemary. Pour over the white wine and bake at 190°C for about 90 minutes, until well browned.
ricetta_13_ingredienti: 1 chicken, cut into pieces, bell peppers, olives, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, white wine
ricetta_13_preparazione: Brown the chicken in oil with garlic, then add the sliced peppers, olives and cherry tomatoes. Deglaze with white wine and cook covered for 40 minutes over medium heat.
ricetta_14_ingredienti: 1kg potatoes, 500g lampascioni (wild grape hyacinth bulbs), olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt
ricetta_14_preparazione: Cut the potatoes and lampascioni into pieces and dress with oil, garlic and rosemary. Arrange in a baking pan and bake at 200°C for about 45 minutes until golden and crispy.
ricetta_15_ingredienti: 400g burnt wheat semolina pasta, cherry tomatoes, breadcrumbs, garlic, olive oil
ricetta_15_preparazione: Cook the pasta in salted water. Meanwhile, sauté the garlic with the crumbled breadcrumbs until crispy. Toss the pasta with sautéed cherry tomatoes and finish with the crispy breadcrumbs.
ricetta_16_ingredienti: 300g blanched almonds, 250g sugar, water, lemon zest
ricetta_16_preparazione: Dissolve the sugar with a little water until it caramelizes. Add the almonds and stir until they are coated with a layer of crystallized white sugar. Leave to cool on baking paper.
ricetta_17_ingredienti: 500g flour, 100ml cooked wine (vin cotto), 100ml olive oil, sugar, fennel seeds, yeast
ricetta_17_preparazione: Knead together flour, cooked wine, oil, sugar and fennel seeds. Shape the taralli, briefly boil in water and then bake at 180°C for 25 minutes until golden.
ricetta_18_nome: St. Joseph's Day Fritters (Zeppole di San Giuseppe)
ricetta_18_ingredienti: 250g flour, water, butter, eggs, oil for frying, pastry cream, sour cherries
ricetta_18_preparazione: Prepare a choux pastry with water, butter, flour and eggs. Fry spoonfuls of batter in hot oil until puffed and golden. Fill with pastry cream and decorate with a sour cherry.
ricetta_19_ingredienti: 300g flour, 150g butter, sugar, eggs, pastry cream or jam
ricetta_19_preparazione: Prepare a shortcrust pastry with flour, butter, sugar and eggs. Line small moulds, fill with pastry cream and cover with a disc of pastry. Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.
ricetta_20_ingredienti: 400g toasted almonds, 300g honey, 100g sugar, wafer sheets
ricetta_20_preparazione: Heat the honey and sugar until a golden syrup forms. Add the toasted almonds and stir quickly. Pour between two wafer sheets, press down and leave to cool before cutting into pieces.
ricetta_21_ingredienti: 500g flour, white wine, olive oil, honey, cooked wine (vin cotto), oil for frying
ricetta_21_preparazione: Knead the flour with wine and oil, roll out thin sheets and curl them into a rose shape. Fry in hot oil until golden and crispy, then dip in warm honey or cooked wine.
ricetta_22_ingredienti: 1 litre milk, 6 eggs, 200g sugar, lemon zest, caramel
ricetta_22_preparazione: Beat the eggs with the sugar, add the hot lemon-flavoured milk. Pour into a caramel-lined mould and bake in a water bath for one hour. Leave to cool before serving.
ricetta_23_ingredienti: 6 Gargano lemons, 200g sugar, water, mint leaves
ricetta_23_preparazione: Make a syrup with water and sugar, leave to cool. Add the strained lemon juice and churn in an ice cream maker until creamy. Serve with a mint leaf.
ricetta_24_ingredienti: 300g ground almonds, 200g sugar, 4 eggs, lemon zest, baking powder
ricetta_24_preparazione: Whisk the eggs with the sugar, fold in the ground almonds, lemon zest and baking powder. Pour into a buttered cake tin and bake at 170°C for 40 minutes.
ricetta_25_ingredienti: 500g flour, yeast, olive oil, sugar, raisins, milk
ricetta_25_preparazione: Knead together flour, yeast, milk, oil and sugar, and let rise for 2 hours. Spread in a greased baking pan, scatter with raisins and sugar and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.
ricetta_26_ingredienti: 400g flour, eggs, sugar, yeast, orange zest, oil for frying, icing sugar
ricetta_26_preparazione: Knead together flour, eggs, sugar, yeast and orange zest. Shape into rings and fry in hot oil until golden. Dust with icing sugar while still warm.
ricetta_27_ingredienti: 200g sliced caciocavallo cheese, 4 eggs, olive oil, pepper, bread to accompany
ricetta_27_preparazione: Melt the sliced caciocavallo in a pan with a little oil until stringy and lightly golden. Add the eggs and cook them together with the cheese like a soft omelette. Season with pepper and serve hot with slices of bread.
ricetta_28_ingredienti: 1kg cleaned cardoons, meat broth, eggs, grated pecorino, small meatballs (optional)
ricetta_28_preparazione: Clean the cardoons, removing the strings, and cut into pieces, then boil them in hot broth until tender. Beat the eggs with the pecorino and pour into the hot broth while stirring to form little egg strands. Serve piping hot.
ricetta_29_ingredienti: 300g whole almonds, 400g sugar, water, flavourings as desired
ricetta_29_preparazione: Cook the sugar with a little water to form a syrup. Pour it over the almonds in several rounds, stirring in a bowl, repeating the process until a smooth white shell forms.
ricetta_30_ingredienti: 500g flour, white wine, olive oil, sugar, anise seeds
ricetta_30_preparazione: Knead together flour, wine, oil, sugar and anise seeds. Shape into sticks, briefly boil in boiling water and then bake at 180°C until golden and crispy.
